subject.title: fix(gateway): don't retire parent Codex binding when creating a detached dashboard child

question: Should `sessions.create` expose the proposed tri-state `succeedsParent` compatibility contract, where omission preserves legacy rollover for eligible explicit successor keys?
rationale: This is an additive public Gateway protocol and generated-client contract whose default determines whether existing callers retire parent session state; source review cannot establish the intended permanent API policy.

options.title: Approve tri-state contract
options.body: Keep the additive boolean, preserve eligible legacy behavior when omitted, and require explicit caller disposition for new in-repo paths.

options.title: Use a disposition enum
options.body: Replace the boolean with an explicit parallel-versus-successor enum and define a deliberate compatibility strategy for omitted legacy calls.

options.title: Keep the decision internal
options.body: Avoid new public protocol surface and pass a trusted internal disposition only from known Control UI and TUI entry points.

recommendation.title: Approve tri-state contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive boolean, preserve eligible legacy behavior when omitted, and require explicit caller disposition for new in-repo paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged lifecycle implementation and tests for Control UI `/new` are directly associated with this person.
